issues.description: Method Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md) declares messageOnFeed() as public (UML shows '+' on the abstract method), while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares it as protected (`protected abstract String messageOnFeed();`). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the implementation can confuse students about the expected access level and may cause tests or example code that assume a public method to behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method declaration in Animal.java public to match the UML/specification: change to `public abstract String messageOnFeed();`. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly indicate protected visibility so all artifacts (spec, template, solution, and tests) are consistent.
